prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Polonium (Po) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks, a fume hood and shelves of labelled reagent bottles
Weather / season: spring — blossom petals drifting outside.
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a flowing ballroom gown with a fitted bodice — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — strong light from behind passes through the thin outer fabric, so the outline of her figure shows as a soft silhouette inside it; the inner layer stays fully opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with both hands she holds a small sealed capsule glowing faint blue and warm with its own heat in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — polonium: a rare silvery metal found in July 1898 by a husband-and-wife pair of chemists in pitchblende and named for Poland, the wife's homeland then erased from the map, so the world would not forget it; so fiercely radioactive that a small piece heats itself to hundreds of degrees and makes the air around it glow blue; polonium-210 lasts only 138 days before decaying into quiet lead; it once kept a rover warm through the long lunar night — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite, small-framed — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

observations: 1024x1536 verified; one main adult woman; painterly anime finish.
Profile seated laboratory scene, both hands hold the capsule, both feet in frame.
Silhouette situation is less pronounced than planned and the skirt ends above the floor.
qa.cause: Documented composition/costume/text deviation from the submitted prompt; original generated image retained without regeneration.
